diagnosis: The GetCertificateDetails function retrieves course certificate records using sqlx without verifying that the caller is the student who earned the certificate. While certificate information has relatively low sensitivity, it exposes students' course enrollment and completion history.
exploit_request:
GET /courses/certificates/CERT-2024-8841 HTTP/1.1
Host: academy.learningportal.org
Authorization: Bearer student_token_44
Accept: application/json
